title.zh: 将高山省 Bontoc 市镇 Mainit 描笼涯的 Guina-Ang 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Mainit 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Guina-Ang National High School - Mainit Extension in Barangay Mainit, Municipality of Bontoc, Mountain Province From the Guina-Ang National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Mainit National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Guina-Ang National High School - Mainit Extension in Barangay Mainit, Municipality of Bontoc, Mountain Province From the Guina-Ang National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Mainit National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Mainit của Trường Trung học Guina-Ang Quốc gia tại Barangay Mainit, Đô thị Bontoc, Tỉnh Mountain Province khỏi Trường Trung học Guina-Ang Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Mainit Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Mainit ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Guina-Ang แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Mainit เทศบาล Bontoc จังหวัด Mountain Province ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Guina-Ang แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Mainit แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Mainit, Sekolah Menengah Guina-Ang Nasional di Barangay Mainit, Kotamadya Bontoc, Provinsi Mountain Province dari Sekolah Menengah Guina-Ang Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Mainit Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Mainit, Sekolah Menengah Guina-Ang Kebangsaan di Barangay Mainit, Perbandaran Bontoc, Wilayah Mountain Province daripada Sekolah Menengah Guina-Ang Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Mainit Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Guina-Ang National High School - Mainit Extension in Barangay Mainit, Municipality of Bontoc, Mountain Province is hereby separated from the Guina-Ang National High School and converted into an independent elementary school to be known as Mainit National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Guina-Ang National High School - Mainit Extension are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Mainit National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Mainit National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the Guina-Ang National High School - Mainit Extension. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Within one hundred twenty (120) days after the approval of this Act, the Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
